criteria.title: Pre-Certification Gap Identification
criteria.coverage: Structured intake and SHA validation/testing before sign-off; all critical defects must be resolved before sign-off.
criteria.rationale: Awaiting initial intake and autonomous preflight run.

criteria.title: Uniform Benefits Matrix & Access Rules
criteria.coverage: HIE (Health Information Exchange) and SHA benefit and access-rule fixtures and claim/preauthorization assertions.
criteria.rationale: Requires isolated test instance connection to run benefit matrix fixtures.

criteria.title: Standardized Patient Journey Capture
criteria.coverage: Journey API checks, Visit ID propagation, clinical evidence and claim traceability.
criteria.rationale: Covers registration, SHR Visit ID assignment, clinical encounters and Kenya Patient Summary linkage.

criteria.title: User Capacity & Training
criteria.coverage: Structured, validated in-person/hybrid plan for relevant facility and hospital user roles; track completion and reviewer evidence.
criteria.rationale: Submit structured training plan and role completion evidence; completion is verified by reviewer.

criteria.title: Minimum Integration Requirements
criteria.coverage: Automated system check preflight, supported profiles, security, required integrations and data exchange.
criteria.rationale: Connect isolated test environment to verify TLS, scopes, FHIR ke-kps-patient profile and SHR staging.

criteria.title: Claims & Patient Journey Visibility
criteria.coverage: Claim/notification correlation, status progression and facility/platform-level views.
criteria.rationale: Assesses end-to-end claim submission, adjudication stage correlation and facility visibility.

criteria.title: Authorizations and Claims Tracking
criteria.coverage: Authorization and preauthorization lifecycle, claim linkage, submission and response tracking.
criteria.rationale: Verifies single-use preauthorization tokens, consumed-token rejection and claim state tracking.

journeyStages.title: Environment and identity preflight
journeyStages.autonomousChecks: Test instance identity, supported release, credentials/scopes, connectivity, encryption, fixture reset, synthetic-data marker, safe target allowlist.
journeyStages.expectedResult: TLS verified, synthetic fixture pack loaded, target allowlist confirmed

journeyStages.title: Patient registration and identity
journeyStages.autonomousChecks: Register/find synthetic patient; validate CR number where required; exercise consent and configured OTP/identity proof at registration; ensure identity is not duplicated.
journeyStages.expectedResult: Synthetic CR patient resolved without duplicate registration

journeyStages.title: Visit creation
journeyStages.autonomousChecks: Obtain centrally assigned Visit ID from SHR before journey; retain it as a correlation key and confirm it is present in subsequent clinical documents.
journeyStages.expectedResult: Authoritative SHR Visit ID issued and bound to encounter context

journeyStages.title: Eligibility, benefits and access
journeyStages.autonomousChecks: Query the configured HIE/SHA benefit/access source; validate entitlement, facility/service rules and response handling using approved fixtures.
journeyStages.expectedResult: Uniform benefits matrix rules and facilityKEPH level entitlements enforced

journeyStages.title: Authorization and preauthorization
journeyStages.autonomousChecks: Create/read decision, validate authorization state and token; test single use, scope, patient/visit linkage and consumed-token rejection.
journeyStages.expectedResult: Single-use token accepted once; replay attempt rejected with audit record

journeyStages.title: Clinical encounter and orders
journeyStages.autonomousChecks: Create structured encounter/progress/surgical notes; check required sections; create orders; ensure encounter and order IDs can be traced to visit and later claim lines.
journeyStages.expectedResult: Structured clinical notes signed; immutable audit trail and order lineage verified

journeyStages.title: Admission, care, pharmacy and discharge
journeyStages.autonomousChecks: Check system-derived admission/discharge times and bed occupancy; enforce bed-night condition; reconcile dispensed medication, stock batch and formulary/quantity; confirm discharge identity/OTP.
journeyStages.expectedResult: Bed-night boundary enforced; pharmacy stock batch and formulary limits reconciled

journeyStages.title: Claim assembly and validation
journeyStages.autonomousChecks: Build claim from native clinical records; validate Visit ID and patient summary; re-derive dates; validate duplicate, tariff, bundling, preauthorization, procedure authorization and location.
journeyStages.expectedResult: Claim lines trace 1:1 to clinical orders; unbundled or duplicate lines blocked

journeyStages.title: FHIR summary and SHR exchange
journeyStages.autonomousChecks: Generate a machine-readable Kenya Patient Summary (ke-kps-patient profile) for every claim; validate required patient/summary resources and Visit ID; submit or stage referenced resources to SHR.
journeyStages.expectedResult: Valid ke-kps-patient FHIR bundle staged with matching SHR Visit ID

journeyStages.title: Claim submission and response
journeyStages.autonomousChecks: Submit to the designated sandbox; correlate acknowledgment, adjudication/processing stage and notification; test duplicate handling and preserve response/status transitions.
journeyStages.expectedResult: Sandbox claim acknowledged; duplicate replay rejected; notification correlated

journeyStages.title: End-to-end visibility
journeyStages.autonomousChecks: Confirm patient/visit, authorization, claim, response and notification can be traced in a facility/platform-level view and can support an assigned case review.
journeyStages.expectedResult: Complete patient journey and claim status visible across facility trace view

fraudControls.outcomeToVerify: Every claim has a machine-readable Kenya Patient Summary (ke-kps-patient); required clinical context is present and valid CR number is handled.
SHR assigns a Visit ID before the journey; clinical documents and printable IPS/claim artifacts reference it; required FHIR resources are submitted/staged to SHR.
Claim/preauth dates are derived from the clinical source of truth; future end-date, overlap and duplicate-date cases are handled and corrections are auditable.
Inpatient claim is blocked where admission and discharge do not cross at least one full bed-night, according to approved date/time policy.
Clinical surgical/progress documentation requires configured structured sections before claim workflow proceeds.
fraudControls.evidenceDetail: API field validation + video if UI behavior is required

fraudControls.outcomeToVerify: Claim cannot rely only on external/paper notes where native HMIS documentation is required; required native record/supporting summary is linked.
Claim line items trace to clinical encounters/orders; unauthorized freehand line creation or mismatched mappings are blocked or flagged per approved rule.
fraudControls.evidenceDetail: API lineage assertions + manual UI check

fraudControls.outcomeToVerify: Signed/locked notes cannot be silently changed; amendments preserve original, author, time and lineage.
Duplicate encounter/claim submission is detected for the approved patient/provider/time-window rules and produces a traceable outcome.
Procedure coding is constrained by verified diagnosis/order and authorized role; unauthorized higher code selection is blocked or escalated.
fraudControls.evidenceDetail: API authorization tests + video for user interaction

fraudControls.outcomeToVerify: Ward/per-diem charges reconcile to bed assignment/occupancy evidence; manual tariff substitution cannot silently override the derived amount.
Approved procedure package rules collapse the defined component codes into the intended bundled code without duplicate billing.
fraudControls.evidenceDetail: API test cases + versioned mapping evidence

fraudControls.outcomeToVerify: Configured advanced imaging/specialized lab claim is blocked without valid approved preauthorization.
Admission/discharge timestamps use system-of-record values; changes require authorized, justified and audited override.
Facility location is validated for preauthorization/claim workflows according to approved geo-source, radius and failure policy.
Configured patient identity/OTP/biometric checks occur at required registration and discharge points; claim posting cannot substitute for discharge verification.
fraudControls.evidenceDetail: API flow + video for physical/user action

fraudControls.outcomeToVerify: Dispensed/claimed medicines reconcile to stock movement, batch and return/reconciliation records.
Formulary and quantity limits are versioned and applied to prescribing/claim workflows, including approved exception paths.
SSO/MFA and provider/practitioner identity controls are active as required by approved policy; test impersonation/shared-credential cases are rejected or detected.
Role-to-task rules prevent users from creating/signing clinical records outside their assigned professional scope.
Post-claim changes/overrides record actor, time, before/after context and required reason; unauthorized changes are blocked.
fraudControls.evidenceDetail: API role tests + immutable audit evidence

fraudControls.outcomeToVerify: A preauthorization token is single-use and cannot be reused across claims; rejected attempts remain visible.
